items.title: Bombay High Court orders takedown of AI deepfakes, derogatory content against Samantha Ruth Prabhu
items.summary: The Bombay High Court today ordered the takedown of content found misusing the name, image and voice of actress Samantha Ruth Prabhu [ Samantha Ruth Prabhu v. John Doe & Ors ]. Justice Madhav Jamdar passed the interim order on a plea filed by Prabhu seeking the protection of her personality rights. The Court has restrained the publication of objectionable content that involve the unauthorised use of the name, image, and voice of the actress, including deepfakes created through the use of artificial intelligence. The Court passed the order after noting that the content flagged by Prabhu in her personality rights suit - including morphed content and deepfakes - demonstrated a prima facie violation of the actor's personality, publicity, and moral rights. “The plaintiff's (Samantha Prabhu's) personality rights and publicity rights are protected by Article 19(1)(a) of the Constitution of India, that is, the right to freedom of speech and expression, as also by Article 21 of the Constitution of India, that is, the right to life and personal liberty, including the right to privacy and the right to human dignity, and her moral rights as a performer are separately protected under Section 38
